say:1:1130311001:1.text: Of course, I'm an adept hunter. It's perhaps my most crucial survival skill.
say:1:1130311001:1.source_cn: 当然是了，我捕猎的本领的确不错，算是我重要的生存技能之一。
say:1:1130311001:1.male: Of course, I'm an adept hunter. It's perhaps my most crucial survival skill.
say:1:1130311001:1.female: Of course, I'm an adept hunter. It's perhaps my most crucial survival skill.

say:2:1130311002:1.text: But wild sandbeast is a difficult catch. I've divvied out the other parts among my friends here.
say:2:1130311002:1.source_cn: 不过，这只野猪可不是那么容易捕获的。其他的部分我已经分...
say:2:1130311002:1.male: But wild sandbeast is a difficult catch. I've divvied out the other parts among my friends here.
say:2:1130311002:1.female: But wild sandbeast is a difficult catch. I've divvied out the other parts among my friends here.

say:3:1130311003:1.text: If hunting and trapping interests you, come visit me later.
say:3:1130311003:1.source_cn: 如果你也对捕猎有兴趣，以后可以来找我。
say:3:1130311003:1.male: If hunting and trapping interests you, come visit me later.
say:3:1130311003:1.female: If hunting and trapping interests you, come visit me later.

say:4:1130311004:1.text: I can teach you all manner of hunting techniques for a fee.
say:4:1130311004:1.source_cn: 我会教给你各种捕猎的技巧和经验的，不过，你多少得给我些学费。
say:4:1130311004:1.male: I can teach you all manner of hunting techniques for a fee.
say:4:1130311004:1.female: I can teach you all manner of hunting techniques for a fee.
